category: P only; no V or T
galaxy_order: Identical to original P order; no resampling or membership changes
primary_metric: CE of probability mass in identical 300 bins over [0,4.5]

bootstrap.rule: Same saved galaxy indices reused for every model/condition/domain and principal contrast; percentile 95%; conditional on fixed checkpoints and this cohort, no training-seed uncertainty

smoke.rule: Lowest SHA256(1027031:galaxy_id), restored to original order
smoke.purpose: Implementation and computational feasibility only; no counterfactual redshift metrics scored or selected

baseline_gate: Archived full-P B/C metrics reproduced first; live first-256 replay for B/C both domains before smoke. Full B/C live replay, exact logits/PDFs, must finish before any full counterfactual inference.
perturbation_selection: Every condition fixed from registry/seeds before new counterfactual predictions; no target-label construction or checkpoint/condition selection

designs.both_domains: Each condition applied to both real observational representations, with globally consistent physical-profile mappings
designs.target_only: Derived contrast using perturbed Legacy and unchanged correct-C HSC; no separate inference needed; labelled target-side effect

resource_plan: All 12 counterfactuals in both domains on all 61,696 P galaxies, after B/C full replay; three idle MIG slices; durable chunked background queue
